description_en: Creates a job and runs a task
kebab_example: aliyun iacservice create-job --client-token 2daf4227f747cbf11a5501f18cc5e004 --description description --sub-command refresh --task-type Task --task-id task-433aead756057fffeaba4828f5195 --api-version 2021-08-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateJob

parameters.description_en: The idempotence token. Format: [0-9a-zA-Z-]{1,64}. We recommend that you use a UUID.

parameters.help_en: The job description. Length: 1 to 64 characters

parameters.description_en:
The operation command. Valid values:

- plan: performs a preview. This is the default value.
- refresh: refreshes the resource status.
- destroy: destroys resources.
parameters.description_zh:
指定操作命令
取值：

- plan： 执行预览（默认值）
- refresh ：刷新资源状态
- destroy： 销毁资源
